WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PLT) as group_avg
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
  WHERE L.PLT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
),
differences AS (
  SELECT gs.ID, gs.SEX, gs.group_avg, oa.overall_avg, gs.group_avg - oa.overall_avg as diff_from_overall
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
sex_avg_diff AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(diff_from_overall) as sex_avg_diff
  FROM differences
  GROUP BY SEX
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.group_avg, d.diff_from_overall, sad.sex_avg_diff
  FROM differences d
  JOIN sex_avg_diff sad ON d.SEX = sad.SEX
  WHERE d.diff_from_overall > sad.sex_avg_diff
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) as avg_group_plt,
  AVG(diff_from_overall) as avg_diff_from_overall,
  AVG(diff_from_overall - sex_avg_diff) as avg_diff_minus_sex_avg
FROM filtered
